ata-write-guard: Storage fix. It adds no LCD page or panel control.
batch-bugfixes: Changes MIDI triggering, Part changes, and a trig LED. It adds no LCD page.
boot-trace: Diagnostic MIDI output during boot. It adds no LCD page.
cc-feedback: Changes outgoing MIDI CC messages. It adds no LCD page or panel control.
cc-map: Maps incoming MIDI CC messages to existing parameter pages. It adds no LCD page.
cfmeter-idle: Supplies idle-time measurements to CF Meter; it has no separate screen. See the CF Meter captures.
erase-empty-trigless-locks: Changes trig LED behaviour when the final lock is erased. The LCD is unchanged.
lofi-amf-fix: Corrects LO-FI audio processing. The stock controls and LCD are unchanged.
mode-defaults: Updates existing effect values when MODE changes. It has no separate screen; see the effect's setup page.
recorder-loop-fix: Corrects recorder playback and loop timing. It adds no LCD page or panel control.
rig-hosts: Sets new Parts' effect assignments. It has no separate screen; the bus pages show the resulting assignments.
store: Shared project-file handling. It adds no LCD page or panel control.
tempo-sync: Changes the existing delay TIME readout and MIDI note handling. It has no separate screen; see the bus delay and TEMPO controls.
waveload: Uses CF Meter's BURN control to select the number of wave engines. It has no separate screen. See the CF Meter captures.
midi-part-state: Shared native Part storage and playback context for MIDI Loopback. It adds no separate LCD page or panel control.
edit-events: Shared held-step editor and copy dispatch. It adds no LCD page or panel control.
